- any “shadow” logic that behaves differently under sparse signals (often causes near-zero performance in some folds).

If you paste the contents of `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` here after it’s generated, I can translate it into a concrete set of next candidate edits (what to revert/adjust and what to try next).
